name: browser
description:
Browser: Cypheria's built-in browser.

Aliases: @browser, @browser-use, in-app browser.

Use the built-in browser when the user asks to open, inspect, navigate, test, click, type, or screenshot local web targets such as localhost, 127.0.0.1, file URLs, dApps, or a built-in browser tab. After significant frontend changes to a local app, open the relevant local page in it when the target is known.

The agent controls it through Cypheria's Computer Use runtime (`cua_repl`, `cua.iab`).

interface.longDescription: Lets the Agent open and operate tabs in Cypheria's built-in browser — local development pages, files, and dApps — to navigate, inspect, click, type, and take screenshots. Wallet requests from dApp tabs still go through Cypheria's signing policy and your approval.
interface.defaultPrompt: Test my checkout flow on localhost:3000
